indexes.name: active_public_lead
indexes.purpose: Internal expiry reconciliation finds the private instance without adding private instance identity to publicMapLeads or request-time private joins.

trustedDecisionPort: Internal authenticated backend only; read(sourceId, sourceVersion, tx) must bind authoritative Founder decision, independent item rights and exact note safety in the same final transaction. No client-supplied proof or self-approval.
productionIntegration: Not applied. A future exact-diff-authorized batch must bind real authorities, policy, maintenance timer and transaction store and verify actual SDK/index/readback behavior. Do not replay Phase1/2 resources or bridge batches.
rollback: Local artifacts can be discarded independently. Before any future apply, preserve the actual current remote baseline and form a new exact diff; reject network admission and hide/retire network supports through the shared projector, retaining source/audit history and valid PLAYER supports. No destructive cleanup.
